newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Maoming Petro gets approval for A share listing.
newsitem.headline: Maoming Petro gets approval for A share listing.

text.p: Guangdong-based Maoming Petrochemical Shihua Co Ltd has been given approval by the China Securities Regulatory Commission to list 17.20 million A shares in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

The A shares were offered at face value of one yuan per share in 1988 and Guangdong Securities has been named Shihua's listing promoter, the official told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter.
The timing of the listing will be decided by the Shenzhen bourse, he added.

Shihua, based in the city of Maoming in southern Guangdong province, currently has a total share capital of 50.31 million shares, including 8.14 million state shares, 24.97 million legal person shares and 17.20 million A shares.

The firm's state shares are held by China's giant Maoming Petrochemical Co, which has an annual capacity to turn out 300,000 tonnes of ethylene and refine 8.50 million tonnes of crude oil, the official said.

Shihua is mainly engaged in production of polypropylene, with an output of 15,000 tonnes in 1995, he said without giving a comparative figure. Shihua is forecasting net profits of 46.60 million yuan for 1996, against 41.50 million last year, he said.
